scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w @nexttour/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nexttour/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexttour/worker && npm run build -w @nexttour/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run start -w @nexttour/api" "npm run start -w @nexttour/worker" "npm run start -w @nexttour/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nexttour/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nexttour/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexttour/worker && npm run typecheck -w @nexttour/web
